plan.title: Flight Plan
plan.empty: No flight plan loaded — enter origin/destination on the MCDU, or fetch an OFP from the INIT page.
plan.hint: Fetch & overrides on the INIT page

gate.title: Arrival Gate
gate.empty: Load an OFP to enable gate assignment.
gate.restored: Restored from the last session — this gate was confirmed before the app restarted.
gate.sendNow.title: Push the gate to GSX and SayIntentions ATC immediately
gate.queued: Queued {0} — auto-send at cruise (or at once when already past it)
gate.hint: Confirm queues for auto-send at cruise (or at once when confirmed later in the flight). Send Now pushes to GSX + SayIntentions ATC immediately. A confirmed gate survives an app restart.

notams.title: NOTAM highlights
notams.none: The plan carries no NOTAMs (SimBrief sends them only when its NOTAM option is on).
notams.noHighlights: No runway, taxiway, ILS, lighting, PAPI or threshold NOTAM at either end — the full list stays on your SimBrief briefing.

pushback.straight.title: This flight: pick 'Straight pushback' when GSX shows the direction menu.
pushback.tailRight.title: This flight: pick 'Nose Left / Tail Right' when GSX shows the direction menu.
pushback.auto.title: Back to the suggestion
